description: Blocks DemoBot LLM responses that Galileo's Correctness (factuality) scorer judges incorrect. The correctness preset emits a BOOLEAN, so the condition is score == false (false = incorrect). A numeric operator such as lt makes the Luna evaluator raise 'score False is not numeric', which the engine reports as an evaluator error and fails open — the control can then never fire. payload_field is inert here: selector path '*' selects the whole step, whose input/output keys are used directly. Post-LLM, deny.
